data.description: The Atypical Bin is an outdoor dustbin with wooden slats around the body, held on a black steel stand. The slatted finish lets it sit next to our benches and gazebos without looking out of place, which matters in a landscaped society garden, a resort lawn or a corporate campus. Raising the bin on a stand keeps it off wet ground and makes it easier to empty. It belongs to the garden decor part of our CoreCraft range, and the listed colour is Sand Beige. We share its size, capacity and warranty terms with your quote. If you are planning a full play or gym area, we can mark bin positions on the same layout drawing.

items.pText: The Atypical Bin is an outdoor dustbin with wooden slats around the body, held on a black steel stand. The slatted finish lets it sit next to our benches and gazebos without looking out of place, which matters in a landscaped society garden, a resort lawn or a corporate campus. Raising the bin on a stand keeps it off wet ground and makes it easier to empty. It belongs to the garden decor part of our CoreCraft range, and the listed colour is Sand Beige. We share its size, capacity and warranty terms with your quote. If you are planning a full play or gym area, we can mark bin positions on the same layout drawing.

The Atypical Bin's steel stand can be bolted self-standing or grouted, so it cannot be tipped over or moved. Place bins near benches and entrances rather than inside the safe play area. Empty them regularly in the monsoon so rainwater does not collect inside.
